newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin closes five cents up at 14.57 rgt/kg.
newsitem.headline: KL tin closes five cents up at 14.57 rgt/kg.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price rose five cents to 14.57 ringgit ($5.77) a kg, aided by short-covering from European and local buyers, despite overnight falls on the London Metal Exchange (LME), traders said.
"There was not much selling as there was no real pressure from the LME's fall," said a trader. "So, the market rebounded a little when there was covering."
Bids outnumbered offers by 80 tonnes to 69. Turnover was 75 tonnes against 44 on Friday. The local premium against London widened to $160 a tonne from $65 previously, traders said.
